svg.title: CHISUM: Stern ramp: hydraulic diagram, JS3-304 revision 1
svg.text: Stern ramp: hydraulic diagram, sheet 2 of 4 · JS3-304 · revision 1 · 12 November 2026
How the oil goes. Drawn with every valve at rest and the ramp raised and locked. Line A (red) carries the ramp: it is the cylinders' rod side.
Pressures in bar. Pipe sizes: outside diameter x wall, mm.
TANK 1,500 litres · level glass · LS1 level low · TS1 temperature high · breather and filler · drain cock · drip tray under
change-over cock: the hand pump to the ramp
F1 pressure filter, 10 micron, clogging lamp
C1 oil cooler, fan M4 1.1 kW
plugged until the ramp cover is built
VALVE STAND, on the hydraulic pump room's inboard wall (HYD-10): each valve by its solenoids from the control stand, or by its lever here
TV1 lowering speed: throttle with free return
A 30 x 4 rod sides: raises and holds
port cylinder, RMP-03: bore 300, rod 170, stroke 3.40 m
starboard cylinder, RMP-04: bore 300, rod 170, stroke 3.40 m
LH1, LH2: load-holding valves bolted to the cylinders, set 250 bar,
opened by the pressure in line B: a burst hose or pipe does not drop the ramp
each fed by hoses from the headers; S: its position switch
INTERLOCK: V1 lowers only with both latches and all ten cleats away (S)
Axial piston, variable delivery, each with a pressure compensator set to 195
bar: it holds that pressure and delivers what the valves ask for, up to 100
l/min. Under M1, M2 of 37 kW on the tank's lid
Gear, 8 l/min at 160 bar, under M3 of 4 kW
About 20 cm³ a stroke: the cleats; the ramp through the change-over cock
210 bar on the main line; 160 bar on the cleats' line
Pressure, 10 micron; return, 25 micron, each with a clogging switch
Air-blast, fan M4 of 1.1 kW, in the return line
0 to 250 bar. Main pressure on the pressure block; lines A and B on the valve
stand. Each on a gauge cock on a port in the block's top
Four-way, three positions, spring-centred; middle: A and B to the tank (the
Four-way, three positions, detented: lock, middle, let go
For the ramp cover over the fixed ramp; its ports are plugged
In line B at the valve stand: sets the lowering speed
Over-centre, bolted to each cylinder's rod-side port, set 250 bar, piloted
Bore 300, rod 170, stroke 3.40 m; at most 952 kN each
Bore 80, stroke 200 mm, each with a position switch
Bore 50, stroke 110 mm, each with a position switch
Single-acting, bore 32, stroke 80 mm, on line D: oil lifts the latch, its
own weight brings it back; no oil holds the ramp
Level low; temperature high: to the alarm relay in the starter panel
0 to 250 bar, 4 to 20 mA, at the valve stand: the system and line A, for
Line A: the cylinders' rod sides
Line B: the cylinders' piston sides
Cleats' pressure, cleat pump to cleat valve
